goal: Allow Bitcoin Core wallet and RPC users to send bitcoin to BIP 352 Silent Payment addresses
Prevent address reuse and protect receiver privacy without relying on third-party wallets
agreement: Concept approval without stated reasons (rkrux, w0xlt)
Concept approval while raising interface and transaction replacement concerns (rustaceanrob)
Unaddressed objections on MSVC build failure, key derivation, and fee-bumping bugs (Yudis-bit)
Nonblocking objection: RBF backward compatibility leaves wallet UI in a confusing state (rustaceanrob)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it adds wallet and RPC support for sending to BIP 352 Silent Payment addresses
Significantly enhances user privacy and avoids address reuse without needing third-party tools
